why: The accident rules follow the named aircraft's ADS-B: a fix 10 s or more after the words, flying normally, holds back the weak words (logged) and lowers the clear ones to the threshold at most; a 7700 squawk adds ADSB_WORSE. A picture over 60 s old is no picture (heard, not on ADS-B).
